brief:
Jewish voters hold views on Israel policy that diverge significantly from media scrutiny of individual candidates, according to polling cited by Zeteo. The outlet noted discrepancies between the intensity of questions directed at politicians like Abdul El-Sayed over their positions on Israel and broader polling data on what Jewish voters actually prioritize.

The report also referenced Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth facing scrutiny, though details on the nature of that accountability were not specified in the summary provided.
dek: While the media lobs absurd questions at Abdul El-Sayed, polls shows voter views on Israel out of whack with such obsessions. MAGA Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, meanwhile, faces a looming reckoning.
title: Polls show Jewish voters' Israel views diverge from media focus on candidates
